description: Details required by Conditions 10 a) drawings showing location of groundwater monitoring borehole(s), and 12 a) no development shall commence (other than demolition above ground level) until an appropriate ground gas and vapour investigation (GVI) is undertaken [incorporating the results of environmental and historical searches and a preliminary risk assessment] and a ground gas and vapour assessment report (GVAR) [where necessary incorporating a Remediation Strategy (RS)], is submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority) of planning permission PP/26/01983 (Extension at basement level, associated lightwell to front, demolition and replacement of rear  extension, extension and bay window at rear first floor level, remodelling and extension of side extension, flat roof lights and extended dormer to roof , alteration to front boundary wall and gates, installation of AC unit within timber enclosure)
